prompt:
Iris?.. Where are we?.. Whose blood is this?
What happened at home?
No.
We're going back.
Iris… did I do it?
Don't. I'll pay and go.
I don't know what I did. Help my sister.
Come with us.
We can't take him.
Fine. Get in the back.
No. He stays.
It's going to be okay.
I don't know what's wrong with me.

Drive. North.
You really don't remember?
…Then drive.
No!
If we go back, they'll lock you up and put me in a home. Drive, Noah!
You don't remember. Then that's how it has to be.
Noah… It's suffering. Do something!
There was a map in here somewhere…
You always hated them.
What are you doing out here all alone?
Get in. Now.
I'm right here. He won't hurt you.
Nobody's coming for him. You can see that.

…Victor, forty-nine, was found dead in his home. Police are searching for his children — his son Noah, nineteen, and his daughter Iris, fifteen. The son may be dangerous. If you have seen…
…about six feet tall, wearing a dark, old-fashioned man's jacket…

Go, kid. I'll make the call in ten minutes.
Hey, kid…
